evidence_summary: Satellite analysis compared observations from 2023-06-04 (before) and 2023-12-16 (after).
Observation quality was high — sufficient for reliable analysis.
No significant vegetation decline detected (NDVI change: 0.019).
Approximately 4.27 hectares of potential forest/vegetation loss were detected between the two observations.
A notable portion of detected change (11.54 ha) falls outside the submitted farm boundary, while 4.27 ha is inside. Boundary verification is recommended.
Note: Satellite evidence identifies potential changes. Field verification is required before drawing legal conclusions.
